yacl3.config.streamermode:config.title: Streamer Mode Configuration
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.categor: Control which types of messages to hide while streaming.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.hideAdm: If enabled, admin messages will be hidden.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.hideMod: If enabled, moderation-related messages will be hidden.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.hideSup: If enabled, support-related messages will be hidden.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.hideDMs: If enabled, direct messages from players will be hidden.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.hidePlo: If enabled, plot advertisements will be hidden.
If enabled, plot boosts will be hidden.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.hideSpy: If enabled, session, DM, and muted spies will be hidden.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.hidePlu: If enabled, update messages will be hidden.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.customR: Custom regex to hide messages that match it.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.group.t: Relay chat messages from Twitch to Minecraft.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.twitchR: Channel ID to receive Twitch chat messages from.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.network: If enabled, Network Protocol Error kicks will be suppressed.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.nonStre: If disabled, you will no longer see a notice when using the mod as a non-streamer.
yacl3.config.streamermode:config.debuggi: If enabled, the mod will print debug messages to the console.
